game.name: Undertale
game.rules:
- ***A video of your run is required in your submission.*** Brief periods of missing video as a result of reloads are permissible as long as the audio is clear and intact throughout. The video must include both the start of the run and the end of the run, except as specified in the category rules. *All videos from Twitch, including highlights and VODs, are not allowed.*

- ***You must start with a 0-reset fresh save file.*** All files in the save directory, except for "config.ini", must be deleted before initiating a run. A guide to finding this directory can be found here: https://pastebin.com/pjcNLQAj. The in-game "True Reset" mechanic does not delete the save files, so it does not count for this requirement.
    - Starting the run with system_information_963 in your save folder (called "soulless" which happens after selling your soul following a genocide run) is permitted in any categories where it doesn't give an advantage. This includes Neutral, True Pacifist, Genocide, and any other single-ending categories, as soulless is equal or worse in these categories. Categories where soulless is not allowed at the start of the run include True 100%, Soulless Pacifist, and Soulless Genocide.
- ***Any edits to the data.win file, in any way shape or form, is an automatic disqualification.*** The only modifications allowed to the game in any capacity are:.
    - Modifications to the .ogg music files in your Undertale directory
    - Removal of steam_api.dll.
    - Running a linux version of the game on a windows operating system by renaming a linux game.unx to data.win and optionally patching an undertale.exe using the provided patches in the resources section
    - Renaming a data.win file (for example having a normal and a debug data.win with different names run through different shortcuts)
    - Unpacking a 1.0 version of the game
    - Modifications to the options.ini file
    - Modifications/removal of splash.png
    - Modifications to credits.txt except in categories that get no-hit Special Thanks or otherwise use credits.txt during the run
- ***Editing or deleting save files during a run is forbidden.*** Reloading to a save file created prior to the start of the run is not allowed. Dying to force a reload to a save file created prior to the start of the run is also not allowed.
- **If any pre-run setups are performed (such as RNG manipulation), the game and category rules apply as soon as the first game client is opened.** Otherwise, the game and category rules apply as soon as timing begins.
    - Pre-run setups, if performed, must also be included in the submission video starting from as soon as the game can be captured.

- ***All IL runs and any sub-hour 1.0-1.001 neutral runs will have milliseconds listed.*** It is not necessary for runners to include the milliseconds themselves on submission

- ***Multi-client is forbidden.*** You can have additional clients open on the main menu for optimal load times, but you cannot interact with an older client after loading a save file (pressing "Continue") with a newer one. An autosave counts as an interaction even if no player input was involved. Closing a client does not count as interaction.
    - Photoshop Flowey fight special rules:
        - Due to the lack of a main menu in the Photoshop Flowey fight, during that instance, you cannot interact with an older client after interacting with a newer one. The Photoshop Flowey fight is defined as starting from when Flowey force closes the game and autosaves (when file8 is created) to ending when the UNDERTALE logo appears after touching the door and the game autosaves.
        - You cannot interact with any clients loaded prior to the autosave that starts the Photoshop Flowey fight after the autosave happens. If you accidentally load a client too early or load a client during a game-write and as a result break this rule, it is okay so long as you immediately close the client and do not interact with it.
        - If you leave the client where you killed Flowey open too long and as a result this client creates an autosave after you've interacted with a newer client, it is allowed as long as your only interaction with this old client or any clients that load this save file is touching the ending door. This exception is intended to allow the runner to reload their normal save file if they accidentally allow this autosave to take place. The ending resulting from this interaction does not count towards category requirements and runs that abuse this exception will be rejected.

- ***External tools must not interface directly with the game.*** This includes reading the game memory or save files. They must also not read data from the game window (e.g. reading the colors of specific pixels) except in a blind manner, such as displaying a screenshot of the game in a different window. External tools may read inputs from the mouse, keyboard, and controller including keypresses that are sent to the game. However, external tools may not attempt to simulate gameplay using game inputs.
    - Autosplitters and automatic kill counters are exceptions to this rule. Autosplitters must not read information that would be unknown to the runner.

- ***Any use of macros to control the game is banned***, with the exception of using a hotkey to start the game and using the half-speed automash mod available in the Resources tab. ***No other automashers or macros are permitted*;** this includes features built into keyboard firmware or driver software such as onboard macros, Snap-Tap and other forms of null-bind, Dynamic Keystroke, and other similar features.
- ***The following key rebinds are the only allowed external key rebinds:***
    - Binding the arrow keys to WASD and/or IJKL. You can only bind up to W/I, left to A/J, down to S/K, and right to D/L. You are allowed to use the arrow keys in addition to WASD/IJKL.
    - Moving the keys Z, X, and C within the leftmost 7 letter keys on the bottom row of the keyboard (Z, X, C, V, B, N, and M on a QWERTY keyboard). The three keys must be in the order Z, X, C from left to right and must be on three consecutive keys. You are only allowed to use one key for each of Z, X, and C.
    - Moving the keys Ctrl, Shift, and Enter to the keys /, ', and ]. You can only bind Ctrl to /, Shift to ', and Enter to ]. If you use this key rebind, you must rebind all three keys. You are only allowed to use one key for each of Ctrl, Shift, and Enter.
- ***Any external key rebinds other than the ones listed above are banned.*** Key rebinds done within the game through the Controller/Joypad setup menu are allowed.

- ***Only one version of the game may be used in a run.***

categories.name: Neutral
categories.rules:
- Complete any Neutral Ending. 

- Timing starts on "YES" on name confirmation, and ends when touching the door after Photoshop Flowey.

- If the end of the run is not visible in the video, you must also include video of the credits advancing at least once before the phone call at the end of the run for retiming purposes.

categories.name: True Pacifist
categories.rules:
- Complete the True Pacifist Ending.

- Timing starts on "YES" on name confirmation, and ends when closing the final textbox from Toriel.

- The second half of a Soulless Pacifist run is allowed for submission, as "system_information_963" only affects the ending post-credits and therefore isn't counted.

categories.name: Genocide
categories.rules:
- Complete the Genocide Ending.

- Timing starts on "YES" on name confirmation, and ends on selecting either "ERASE" or "DO NOT" on the final choicer.

categories.name: New Game+
categories.rules:
- Complete a New Game+ ending.

- For this category, a save file that has already been generated can be used to Reset from, meaning a "True Reset" is not required. You cannot load this save file during the run at any point.

categories.name: New Game+ Glitchless
categories.rules:
- Complete a New Game+ ending.

- For this category, a save file that has already been generated can be used to Reset from, meaning a "True Reset" is not required. You cannot load this save file during the run at any point.

- Certain glitches are allowed due to not saving time or being easy to perform on accident. Certain other exploits may appear glitch-like but are not considered glitches. The following exploits/glitches are allowed in glitchless runs:
  - Rock Skip/TAS rock
  - Long elevator skip (1.09+ only)
  - Any cosmetic glitches
  - Speed boosts using wall collision
  - Menu buffering past random encounters
  - Unused text storage
  - Cell phone notification skips
  - Ruins phone call skip
  - "Dating start" skips in the Alphys date
  - Instant face loads in textboxes
  - Smaller battlebox glitch in the Toriel fight
  - Reloading the game to skip cutscenes
  - Tabbing out of the game (1.0 and 1.001 only)
  - Wall clips (walking 1 pixel closer to a wall than normal)
  - 1hp laser textboxes when entering the news room
  - Skipping the cutscene after Muffet when sparing her
  - Triggering Ice Puzzle Skip but falling off before crossing the bridge

- All other glitches are banned from glitchless runs. This includes but is not limited to the following glitches:
  - All wrong warps
  - All punch card glitches
  - Lab Skip/Early Pan (dogfood storage)
  - Undyne Arena OoB (1.0 only)
  - Flying Papyrus (1.0 only)
  - Ice Puzzle Skip
  - Jump Tile Skip (1.0 only)
  - Dogi Skip
  - Lemon Bread Skip
  - Present Vent Skip
  - Sea-grass Skip
  - Geo's strat
  - Mad Dummy Skip
  - Genocide Mettaton text after sparing Muffet or Royal Guards
- Contact a moderator for clarification on whether or not a particular glitch or exploit is banned in glitchless runs.

categories.name: Soulless Pacifist
categories.rules:
- Complete the Soulless Pacifist Ending, done by finishing a Genocide run, selling your SOUL, and then completing a True Pacifist run.

- Timing starts on "YES" on name confirmation for your Genocide run, and ends when closing the final textbox from Toriel in your Pacifist run.

categories.name: All Major Endings
categories.rules:
- Complete every Major Ending.

- Timing starts on "YES" on name confirmation, and ends on:
  - Toriel's final textbox, if you end with True Pacifist.
  - Touching the door after Photoshop Flowey, if you end with a Neutral Ending.
  - Selecting either "ERASE" or "DO NOT" on the final choicer, if you end with Genocide.

You must complete at least one of each of the following Major Endings. The numbers in parentheses correspond to the ending numbers on this flowchart: https://imgur.com/6wNQy8i
- True Pacifist Ending (65-68)
  - Complete any True Pacifist Ending.
- Genocide Ending (90-93)
  - Complete any Genocide Ending.
- Family Ending/Betrayed Undyne Ending (31-64)
  - Complete the Neutral Ending with Toriel, Papyrus, and Undyne alive and less than 10 kills.
- Exiled Queen Ending (5-30)
  - Complete the Neutral Ending with Toriel alive and at least one of the following: 10 or more kills, Papyrus dead, or Undyne dead.
- Undyne Ending (69-74)
  - Complete the Neutral Ending with Toriel dead and Undyne alive.
- Mettaton Ending (75-80)
  - Complete the Neutral Ending with Toriel and Undyne dead and Mettaton alive.
- Papyrus Ending (81-85)
  - Complete the Neutral Ending with Toriel, Undyne, and Mettaton dead and Papyrus alive.
- Dog Ending (86)
  - Complete the Neutral Ending with Toriel, Undyne, Mettaton, and Papyrus dead and exactly 4 kills.
- No King Ending (87-88)
  - Complete the Neutral Ending with Toriel, Undyne, Mettaton, and Papyrus dead, a murder level of less than 12, and a number of kills that is not 4.
- Alphys Ending (89)
  - Complete the Neutral Ending with Toriel, Undyne, Mettaton, and Papyrus dead, and a murder level of 12 or higher.

categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
Complete the level as fast as possible.

Aborted Genocide is not allowed.

Approved Save files are provided in the Resources tab.

Runs may be done on debug mode or the IGT Savestate Mod (available in the Resources tab); however, debug mode features, savestates, or any other modded features affecting gameplay may not be used during the run in any capacity. Use of any such features will result in an automatic disqualification.
- If you use the IGT Savestate Mod, you must use the official version from the Resources tab. Runs using any additional modifications will be rejected regardless of whether the additional modifications appear to affect gameplay. Exceptions to this rule may be made for past runs on a case-by-case basis, due to the history of the IGT Savestate Mod being modified by different people over time prior to being allowed for IL runs.

categories.name: Glitchless

Aborted Genocide is not allowed.

Approved Save files are available in the Resources tab.

- NOTE: Debug mode is banned for Glitchless Hotland ILs, due to strange effects during News Show.

games.name: Undertale
games.rules:
- ***A video of your run is required in your submission.*** Brief periods of missing video as a result of reloads are permissible as long as the audio is clear and intact throughout. The video must include both the start of the run and the end of the run, except as specified in the category rules. *All videos from Twitch, including highlights and VODs, are not allowed.*

- ***You must start with a 0-reset fresh save file.*** All files in the save directory, except for "config.ini", must be deleted before initiating a run. A guide to finding this directory can be found here: https://pastebin.com/pjcNLQAj. The in-game "True Reset" mechanic does not delete the save files, so it does not count for this requirement.
    - Starting the run with system_information_963 in your save folder (called "soulless" which happens after selling your soul following a genocide run) is permitted in any categories where it doesn't give an advantage. This includes Neutral, True Pacifist, Genocide, and any other single-ending categories, as soulless is equal or worse in these categories. Categories where soulless is not allowed at the start of the run include True 100%, Soulless Pacifist, and Soulless Genocide.
- ***Any edits to the data.win file, in any way shape or form, is an automatic disqualification.*** The only modifications allowed to the game in any capacity are:.
    - Modifications to the .ogg music files in your Undertale directory
    - Removal of steam_api.dll.
    - Running a linux version of the game on a windows operating system by renaming a linux game.unx to data.win and optionally patching an undertale.exe using the provided patches in the resources section
    - Renaming a data.win file (for example having a normal and a debug data.win with different names run through different shortcuts)
    - Unpacking a 1.0 version of the game
    - Modifications to the options.ini file
    - Modifications/removal of splash.png
    - Modifications to credits.txt except in categories that get no-hit Special Thanks or otherwise use credits.txt during the run
- ***Editing or deleting save files during a run is forbidden.*** Reloading to a save file created prior to the start of the run is not allowed. Dying to force a reload to a save file created prior to the start of the run is also not allowed.
- **If any pre-run setups are performed (such as RNG manipulation), the game and category rules apply as soon as the first game client is opened.** Otherwise, the game and category rules apply as soon as timing begins.
    - Pre-run setups, if performed, must also be included in the submission video starting from as soon as the game can be captured.

- ***All IL runs and any sub-hour 1.0-1.001 neutral runs will have milliseconds listed.*** It is not necessary for runners to include the milliseconds themselves on submission

- ***Multi-client is forbidden.*** You can have additional clients open on the main menu for optimal load times, but you cannot interact with an older client after loading a save file (pressing "Continue") with a newer one. An autosave counts as an interaction even if no player input was involved. Closing a client does not count as interaction.
    - Photoshop Flowey fight special rules:
        - Due to the lack of a main menu in the Photoshop Flowey fight, during that instance, you cannot interact with an older client after interacting with a newer one. The Photoshop Flowey fight is defined as starting from when Flowey force closes the game and autosaves (when file8 is created) to ending when the UNDERTALE logo appears after touching the door and the game autosaves.
        - You cannot interact with any clients loaded prior to the autosave that starts the Photoshop Flowey fight after the autosave happens. If you accidentally load a client too early or load a client during a game-write and as a result break this rule, it is okay so long as you immediately close the client and do not interact with it.
        - If you leave the client where you killed Flowey open too long and as a result this client creates an autosave after you've interacted with a newer client, it is allowed as long as your only interaction with this old client or any clients that load this save file is touching the ending door. This exception is intended to allow the runner to reload their normal save file if they accidentally allow this autosave to take place. The ending resulting from this interaction does not count towards category requirements and runs that abuse this exception will be rejected.

- ***External tools must not interface directly with the game.*** This includes reading the game memory or save files. They must also not read data from the game window (e.g. reading the colors of specific pixels) except in a blind manner, such as displaying a screenshot of the game in a different window. External tools may read inputs from the mouse, keyboard, and controller including keypresses that are sent to the game. However, external tools may not attempt to simulate gameplay using game inputs.
    - Autosplitters and automatic kill counters are exceptions to this rule. Autosplitters must not read information that would be unknown to the runner.

- ***Any use of macros to control the game is banned***, with the exception of using a hotkey to start the game and using the half-speed automash mod available in the Resources tab. ***No other automashers or macros are permitted*;** this includes features built into keyboard firmware or driver software such as onboard macros, Snap-Tap and other forms of null-bind, Dynamic Keystroke, and other similar features.
- ***The following key rebinds are the only allowed external key rebinds:***
    - Binding the arrow keys to WASD and/or IJKL. You can only bind up to W/I, left to A/J, down to S/K, and right to D/L. You are allowed to use the arrow keys in addition to WASD/IJKL.
    - Moving the keys Z, X, and C within the leftmost 7 letter keys on the bottom row of the keyboard (Z, X, C, V, B, N, and M on a QWERTY keyboard). The three keys must be in the order Z, X, C from left to right and must be on three consecutive keys. You are only allowed to use one key for each of Z, X, and C.
    - Moving the keys Ctrl, Shift, and Enter to the keys /, ', and ]. You can only bind Ctrl to /, Shift to ', and Enter to ]. If you use this key rebind, you must rebind all three keys. You are only allowed to use one key for each of Ctrl, Shift, and Enter.
- ***Any external key rebinds other than the ones listed above are banned.*** Key rebinds done within the game through the Controller/Joypad setup menu are allowed.

- ***Only one version of the game may be used in a run.***

- Time begins on "YES" during name selection and ends as soon as you touch the door after the Photoshop Flowey battle.

- If the end of the run is not visible in the video, you must also include video of the credits advancing at least once before the phone call at the end of the run for retiming purposes.

- You are not allowed to acquire any items or use any items.
